    Playing on Quest
    1. Open this page in the Meta Quest Browser and press Start in your room. Allow passthrough if asked.
    2. Stand in a clear space. The table appears just in front of you; use Recenter table any time to move it.
    3. The paddle is in your right hand. Change hand, paddle angle, assists and ball speed in Settings.
    4. Point at the menu and pull the trigger to choose. Press B or Y to pause.
    5. Spin trails show the spin: red topspin, blue backspin, violet sidespin.
    Desktop controls
    1. Move the mouse to place the paddle. Click and hold to swing forward through the ball.
    2. Click menu buttons to choose. Esc pauses, or leaves from the main menu.
